S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  ABA No.1118 of 2024  Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Sanjay Kumar, Advocate for the applicant.
Ms. Rangoli Purohit, Brief Holder for the State.

Applicant seeks anticipatory bail in Criminal Case No.162 of 2024, State Vs. Dharmendra Kumar Agarwal, in FIR No. 467 of 2023, under Sections 406, 420, 504 and 506 IPC, Police Station Bajpur,
District Udham Singh Nagar,, pending in the court of Civil Judge/Judicial Magistrate Bazpur,
District Udham Singh Nagar.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

It is argued that during investigation, the arrest of the applicant was stayed by the High Court; now,
chargesheet has been filed; it is a case of money transaction; it is a civil dispute.

Having considered the submissions, as an ad interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail subject to his furnishing personal bonds with two sureties, each in the like amount, to the satisfaction of the court concerned.

In addition to it, the applicant shall also comply with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall not approach any witness in any manner, whatsoever.
(ii) He shall not leave the country without prior permission of the court concerned.
(iii) He shall deposit his passport with the court concerned.
The passport may only be returned by the order of the court concerned.
In case, the applicant does not have passport, he shall give an undertaking to that effect to the court concerned.
